Theme Tracker is the Yahoo Finance (Finviz-style) industries plus hand-picked themes. Every stock is listed once: one that belongs to a hand-picked theme (Memory, Cloud, Gold Miners…) is shown there and left out of its industry, and one in two themes stays in the narrower. Each industry holds every other liquid US-listed member (price ≥ $3, $5M+ daily dollar volume; fewer than three such stocks and it is left out), weighted by market cap with no stock above 25%; prices come from a TradingView scan, 15 minutes delayed. RS Rtg (1–99) ranks 2×3M + 6M + 12M return against all ~2,500 of those stocks; RS 1M is the 1-month return minus SPY's. Group ETFs are the hand-picked themes by their ETF plus the index ETFs; S&P Sectors and Equal Weight are the cap- and equal-weight sector ETFs; Country ETFs is the iShares-style country ETFs. During US market hours the snapshot is rebuilt every 15 minutes, so Today reflects the session so far; press Sync (or leave the tab open) to pick up the latest one.
